evidence_snippets: For example, to use JSON Web Tokens, provide a google.auth.jwt.Credentials instance: import json from google.auth import jwt service account info = json.load(open("service-account-info.json")) audience = "https://pubsub.googleapis.com/google.pubsub.v1.Subscriber" credentials = jwt.Credentials.from service account info( service account info, audience=audience ) subscriber = pubsub v1.SubscriberClient(credentials=credentials) The same for the publisher, except that the "audience" claim needs to be adjusted publisher audience = "https://pubsub.googleapis.com/google.pubsub.v1.Publisher" credentials pub = credentials.with claims(audience=publisher audience) publisher = pubsub v1.PublisherClient(credentials=credentials pub) Versioning This library follows Semantic Versioning .
Supported Python Versions Python >= 3.9 Deprecated Python Versions Python < 3.9 The last version of this library compatible with Python 3.7 and 3.8 is google-cloud-pubsub==2.34.0.
The last version of this library compatible with Python 2.7 is google-cloud-pubsub==1.7.0.
